notes: αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ → *that very hour* divides under rule 60 exactly as that rule records: *that* to the article, *very* to the intensive pronoun.

ἀναβλέπω is rendered twice in this verse and differently — *receive thy sight* headed on *sight* under rule 91, *looked up* headed on *looked* with *up* as the preverb under rule 106 — the difference following the ASV's own phrasing and not two analyses.
